messages:
laura: Heads-up — external assessor engagement confirmed for next Tue/Wed. Need to lock KMS proxy window, temp RBAC roles, audit sampling plan, and evidence handoff format. Who can own the packaging + presigned path?

oliver: dates? scope? which envs are in scope (staging/prod)?

laura: dates are 2025-11-18 -> 2025-11-19 UTC. Scope: staging + partner-internal staging only (no prod), network/ingress fuzzing, auth flows, S3 access patterns, and runtime KMS interactions.

priya: For KMS — do assessors need decrypt ability or just encrypted-object access proofs?

laura: Prefer NOT to grant raw decrypt. We'll spin up a KMS proxy that exposes signing/verify and encrypted-object fetch via presigned URLs. Assessors can request ciphertext and we provide sealed objects for proof. If they need crypto ops, route through a restricted proxy that logs every call.

devops-oncall: I can stand up the proxy and ephemeral roles. Plan: create an ephemeral role via OKTA with ASSESSOR role, TTL 4h, scoped to staging buckets and kms-proxy endpoint. Command I'll run: `./grant-temp-role --principal assessor:acme-team --scopes s3:staging/*,kms-proxy --ttl 4h`

sam: Audit logs — we should predefine sampling queries so we can hand over query outputs quickly. Retention for evidence should be 90 days minimum for this engagement. Any objections?

laura: 90 days sounds fine. Also export raw CloudTrail + internal audit stream for the window. We should mark export snapshots with a manifest + sha256.

oliver: Evidence handoff format proposal: tarball containing `objects/` plus `manifest.jsonl` with sha256 per file. Example manifest line: `{\"path\": \"objects/s3-get-20251118-10:02:11.json\", \"sha256\": \"3b7f...ab12\", \"type\": \"audit\"}`

priya: For KMS proxy logging — what fields do we need? requestor, principal, operation, key_id, request_payload_hash, response_status, timestamp. Also include request_id to tie logs to trace.

laura: Yep, that set is required. Add `authorization_hint` to help map to ephemeral role.

sam: Quick note on sampling queries — recommend we pre-run and include sample counts: `jq '.entries[] | select(.severity>=7) | .eventType' audit_window.json` then attach counts.csv so assessors don't ask for more.

devops-oncall: I'll create an S3 presigned handoff path under `s3://redwood-pt-handoff/acme-20251118/` and put a read-only presigned URL valid for 7 days. Placeholder (will post real URL when ready): `https://presigned.example/redwood-pt/acme-20251118`

oliver: Triage rules for retest: P0/P1 must be fixed before retest slot; P2 mitigated + plan ok; P3 scheduled. Let's formalize severity mapping and owners before the engagement.

priya: Agreed. Also we should capture config snapshots for IAM roles (before/after) and KMS key policy snapshots. Those should be included in the manifest.

laura: Owner matrix: laura -> overall coord + evidence; devops-oncall -> proxy + presigned path; priya -> KMS policy snapshots + triage lead; oliver -> evidence packaging; sam -> audit export + sampling queries.

engsec-bot: calendar created: "External Assessor - Acme staging window" 2025-11-18 09:00 UTC -> 2025-11-19 17:00 UTC. (reminder set)

devops-oncall: Putting checklist in #eng-security-docs: `kms-proxy deployed`, `ephemeral roles configured`, `s3-path provisioned`, `audit export snapshoted`, `manifest generated` — I'll post runbook links shortly.

laura: Can we do a final pre-engagement dry-run tomorrow 10:00 UTC? Quick checklist and test presigned upload/download.

sam: I can be there to validate audit exports and run sample jq filters.

priya: I'll validate KMS proxy logs and simulate a signing call to confirm logging fields.

oliver: I'll prepare a small sample tar + manifest for review so packaging is pre-approved.

laura: Great. Thanks all. Meeting scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
